mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs per month), a tightening labor market fuels wage inflation, pressuring equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to diminished earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in decline periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating a surge in housing market activity, consumer spending is boosted, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% and CPIAUCSL growth decelerates (< 2% YoY), a dovish monetary stance combined with subdued inflation supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in RSAFS, indicating rising retail sales, reflects strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in growth periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS growth decelerates (< 100k new jobs per month) and UNRATE rises above 4%, a weakening labor market signals reduced consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
